_comment: One place the name, the domain and the palette are written down. Everything else reads them from here, so a rebrand is an edit to this file rather than a hunt through five languages. scripts/selftest.py fails if functions/_brand.js drifts from it, because a Worker cannot read this file at runtime and the duplication is therefore the thing that will rot.
name: SLED JOBS
what: Every open sales role at state and local government technology companies.
_domain_comment: Still the old domain until the new one is bought and pointed at Cloudflare Pages. Changing this string and the Pages custom domain is the whole move: alert links, digest footers, the confirmation email and the submission form all read it from here.

fog.use: labels and captions only. 2.7:1, never reading copy

_contrast_comment: Measured on Ice by the kit: Penguin 13.3:1, Badge 5.8:1, Beanie 4.9:1 - all AA for text. Fog is 2.7:1 and is for tiny uppercase labels only. Beak is never text. Eight colours and no pure white; everything is the mascot's own plumage.
